mc-tikka-004.front: Can the Tikka safety go ON when the rifle is uncocked?
mc-tikka-004.back: No. It only engages when cocked. Unloaded, uncocked, safety forward is the transport position (95%).

Panel 3, safety ON: cocked, safety pulled back, red dot hidden. Banner: red dot means it can fire.">

mc-tikka-005.front: How do you take the bolt out?
mc-tikka-005.back: Lift the handle, press the bolt stop on the left side, pull the bolt fully back (95%, pages 8 and 13).

mc-tikka-015.front: Your 10 round Tikka magazine and the 5 round limit?
mc-tikka-015.back: The limit is for magazines designed for semi automatic firearms. A bolt action magazine is not on that list (90%, my reading of SOR/98-462).
